additional_info.subject: RE: ID0462285-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP/T1 170004362] DC1 CableTempSensor XD100 CRM:03056000509
additional_info.body:
Good evening Giuseppe,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0462285
for charger
MP/T1 170004362.
I am writing here to note down our conversation from Teams. I understood that the issue appeared only one time, and after onsite visit from your side, the DC1 CableTempSensor error flag did not appear anymore. Onsite measurements on the pt1000 sensors proved that no HW issue was detected on the cable.
For the moment, we agreed to close this ticket, as the error appeared only one time. If the error will appear again, or it will appear permanently, please open a new ticket.
Thank you for the support!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
